meta.name: conversion-optimization
meta.description: Guided journey from a leaking conversion flow - landing page, signup, checkout, or in-app onboarding - to a measured, tested funnel. Orchestrates six skills phase by phase - lean-analytics, cro-methodology, storybrand-messaging, hundred-million-offers, influence-psychology, design-everyday-things - each phase carries its full method inline so it runs standalone, asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (FUNNEL.md, METRICS.md, EXPERIMENTS.md, CONVERSION-OPTIMIZATION-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to raise conversion on a specific flow, fix checkout or signup abandonment, diagnose onboarding drop-off, or says 'people start but never finish'. With no site yet, use create-website; for a whole-site look, message, and speed audit, improve-website; if the flow converts but needs traffic, grow-website; for in-product engagement and retention, improve-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 诊断并修复转化流程中的流失环节
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用户常在你的购物车或注册页中途放弃。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix drop-offs in your conversion funnel.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often abandon your checkout or signup flow.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你按七阶段优化转化流程：先定位流失点，再研究原因，依次改进信息、报价、证据和操作难度，最后用预设定的实验验证改动。每个决策点都征求你的意见，并把结果记录在 docs/ 文件夹，方便跨会话继续。
howto.when: 当你想提升某个具体流程的转化率、修复结账或注册流失、诊断新手引导流失，或说出“人们开始但从不完成”时，Claude 会接管并开始这个优化旅程。

say.text: 我的落地页访问量不少，但没人注册，帮我优化转化。
say.note: Claude 会启动七阶段旅程，先询问漏斗数据。

say.text: 用户在结账时放弃，我想知道为什么。
say.note: 它会先让你粘贴数据，定位流失点。

say.text: 我们注册流程很多人不完成，诊断一下。
say.note: 会启动流失诊断，要求提供流量数据。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a 7-phase journey: locate leak with data, research why, improve message, offer, proof, friction, and validate each fix with a pre-committed test. It asks at every decision and logs to docs/ for resume.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to raise conversion on a specific flow, fix checkout or signup abandonment, diagnose onboarding drop-off, or say 'people start but never finish'.

say_en.text: My landing page gets traffic but no signups—help optimize conversion.
say_en.note: Claude starts the 7-phase journey and asks for funnel data.

say_en.text: Users abandon at checkout; I want to know why.
say_en.note: It asks for analytics to locate the leak.

say_en.text: Many drop off in our signup flow—diagnose it.
say_en.note: It starts Phase 1 and requests traffic data.
